    40	def fetch_thermal_candidates(
    41	    api_key: Optional[str] = API_KEY,
    42	    max_results: int = 200,
    43	) -> pd.DataFrame:
    44	    """
    45	    Query Materials Project (mp-api) for thermal-management / insulation candidates.
    46	    Includes compounds with at least one of B, C, N, Si, Al.
    47	    Extracts: Material ID, Pretty Formula, Bulk Modulus (VRH avg), Band Gap.
    48	    Drops rows with missing Bulk Modulus or Band Gap.
    49	    """
    50	    elements_filter = ["B", "C", "N", "Si", "Al"]
    51	    criteria = {
    52	        "elements": {"$in": elements_filter},
    53	        "nelements": {"$gte": 1},
    54	    }
    55	
    56	    with MPRester(api_key or os.getenv("MP_API_KEY", API_KEY)) as mpr:
    57	        results = mpr.query(
    58	            criteria,
    59	            [
    60	                "material_id",
    61	                "formula_pretty",
    62	                "bulk_modulus.vrh",
    63	                "band_gap",
    64	            ],
    65	            chunk_size=max_results,
    66	        )
    67	        records = []
    68	        for doc in results:
    69	            bulk_mod = doc.get("bulk_modulus", {}).get("vrh") if isinstance(doc.get("bulk_modulus"), dict) else doc.get("bulk_modulus")
    70	            if bulk_mod is None:
    71	                bm = doc.get("bulk_modulus")
    72	                if isinstance(bm, dict):
    73	                    bulk_mod = bm.get("vrh")
    74	                else:
    75	                    bulk_mod = bm
    76	            records.append({
    77	                "material_id": doc.get("material_id"),
    78	                "formula_pretty": doc.get("formula_pretty"),
    79	                "bulk_modulus_vrh": bulk_mod,
    80	                "band_gap_ev": doc.get("band_gap"),
    81	            })
    82	    df = pd.DataFrame(records)
    83	    df = df.dropna(subset=["bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev"])
    84	    df = df[(df["bulk_modulus_vrh"].notna()) & (df["band_gap_ev"].notna())]
    85	    return df
    86	
    87	
    88	def split_features_targets(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple:
    89	    """
    90	    Separate the processed dataset into feature matrix (X) and target vectors (y).
    91	    Targets: bulk_modulus_vrh and band_gap_ev.
    92	    Returns (X, y_df) where y_df contains only the target columns.
    93	    """
    94	    target_cols = ["bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev"]
    95	    # Identify feature columns (exclude target columns, keep formula_pretty for reference if present)
    96	    feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in target_cols and c != "material_id"]
    97	    X = df[feature_cols].copy()
    98	    y = df[target_cols].copy()
    99	    print(f"[Phase 1] Split complete: X={X.shape}, y={y.shape}, target_columns={list(y.columns)}")
   100	    return X, y

   103	def save_dataset(df: pd.DataFrame, path: str = "materials_thermal_dataset.csv") -> str:
   104	    """
   105	    Save the complete featurized dataset (features + targets + identifiers) to CSV.
   106	    Returns absolute file path.
   107	    """
   108	    try:
   109	        df.to_csv(path, index=False)
   110	        abs_path = os.path.abspath(path)
   111	        print(f"[Phase 1] Complete dataset saved to: {abs_path} ({len(df)} rows x {len(df.columns)} cols)")
   112	        return abs_path
   113	    except Exception as e:
   114	        print(f"[Phase 1] ERROR saving dataset: {e}")
   115	        raise

   118	def build_feature_pipeline() -> MultipleFeaturizer:
   119	    """Assemble matminer MultipleFeaturizer for thermal-management descriptors."""
   120	    feat = MultipleFeaturizer([
   121	        ElementProperty.from_preset(preset_name="magpie"),
   122	        Stoichiometry(),
   123	        ValenceOrbital(orbitals=("s", "p", "d", "f"), props=("avg", "frac")),
   124	        DensityFeatures(),
   125	        SiteStatsFingerprint.from_preset("CrystalNNFingerprint_cn"),
   126	    ])
   127	    return feat
   128	
   129	
   130	def build_feature_matrix(df: pd.DataFrame, formula_col: str = "formula_pretty") -> pd.DataFrame:
   131	    """
   132	    Convert formula strings to composition objects via StrToComposition,
   133	    compute ElementFraction features, and flatten into DataFrame.
   134	    """
   135	    converter = StrToComposition()
   136	    # StrToComposition.featurize returns [Composition]; extract Composition objects
   137	    compositions = [converter.featurize(s)[0] for s in df[formula_col].tolist()]
   138	    ef = ElementFraction()
   139	    # ElementFraction expects Composition objects directly
   140	    frac_features = [ef.featurize(c) for c in compositions]
   141	    # Each result is a list of feature values (length equals feature labels count)
   142	    frac_df = pd.DataFrame(frac_features, columns=[str(c) for c in ef.feature_labels()])
   143	    result = pd.concat([df.reset_index(drop=True), frac_df.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
   144	    return result
   145	
   146	
   147	def extract_features(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
   148	    """
   149	    Convert raw MP structures to composition strings, run matminer featurization,
   150	    and merge back into a feature matrix.
   151	    """
   152	    # Build composition column required by matminer
   153	    df["composition_str"] = df["formula"].apply(lambda f: f if isinstance(f, str) else str(f))
   154	
   155	    featurizer = build_feature_pipeline()
   156	    # Real featurizer invocation on the dataset
   157	    features_df = featurizer.featurize_df(df, col_id="composition_str", multiindex=False)
   158	    return features_df
   159	
   160	
   161	def run_full_pipeline(
   162	    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
   163	    output_path: str = "thermal_materials_features.csv",
   164	    dataset_path: str = "materials_thermal_dataset.csv",
   165	) -> tuple:
   166	    """End-to-end Phase 1 ingestion + feature engineering.
   167	    Returns (output_path, dataset_path, X_shape_tuple, y_shape_tuple).
   168	    Includes exception handling, status prints, dataset save, and feature/target split.
   169	    """
   170	    try:
   171	        print("[Phase 1] Starting full pipeline...")
   172	        print("[Phase 1] Fetching thermal-management candidates from Materials Project...")
   173	        raw_df = fetch_thermal_candidates(api_key=api_key, max_results=200)
   174	        print(f"[Phase 1] Ingested {len(raw_df)} records.")
   175	
   176	        print("[Phase 1] Engineering compositional + structural features via matminer...")
   177	        # Use build_feature_matrix to include targets and identifiers in dataset
   178	        full_df = build_feature_matrix(raw_df, formula_col="formula_pretty")
   179	        # Add back target columns from raw_df for dataset completeness
   180	        full_df["bulk_modulus_vrh"] = raw_df["bulk_modulus_vrh"].values
   181	        full_df["band_gap_ev"] = raw_df["band_gap_ev"].values
   182	        print(f"[Phase 1] Generated feature matrix: {len([c for c in full_df.columns if c not in ['formula_pretty', 'material_id', 'bulk_modulus_vrh', 'band_gap_ev']])} descriptors x {len(full_df)} materials.")
   183	
   184	        # Split features and targets
   185	        X, y = split_features_targets(full_df)
   186	        print(f"[Phase 1] Features shape: {X.shape}, Targets shape: {y.shape}")
   187	
   188	        # Save complete dataset
   189	        dataset_abs = save_dataset(full_df, path=dataset_path)
   190	
   191	        # Write engineered feature-only dataset (optional legacy output)
   192	        full_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
   193	        print(f"[Phase 1] Feature matrix written to: {os.path.abspath(output_path)}")
   194	
   195	        result = {
   196	            "output_path": os.path.abspath(output_path),
   197	            "dataset_path": dataset_abs,
   198	            "X_shape": X.shape,
   199	            "y_shape": y.shape,
   200	            "record_count": len(full_df),
   201	        }
   202	        print(f"[Phase 1] Pipeline complete. Results: {result}")
   203	        return result
   204	    except Exception as e:
   205	        print(f"[Phase 1] ERROR in run_full_pipeline: {e}")
   206	        raise
   207	
   208	
   209	if __name__ == "__main__":
   210	    result_dict = run_full_pipeline()
   211	    print("Pipeline complete. Result keys:", list(result_dict.keys()))
